title: Personal Loans Late Fees: AutoPay-History Share
content:
## Rule

An AutoPay-history share of a Personal Loans late fee applies, counting the AutoPay debits posted on the loan fewer than 24 whole calendar months (whole calendar months being the difference in calendar months, less one when the later date's day of the month is smaller than the earlier date's) before the late fee's assessment date less the AutoPay debits returned in those months: 20 or more give 0.95; 12 to 19 give 0.97; fewer than 12 give no late-fee share. An AutoPay debit is any payment AutoPay took on the loan, a hardship plan payment included, and an AutoPay debit returned is a return of such a payment.

The share multiplies the late-fee figure while it is still unrounded, before the late fee is held to no more than the unpaid portion of the installment and rounded to the cent once, at the end.

| AutoPay debits posted less AutoPay debits returned, fewer than 24 whole months back | Share |
|---|---|
| 20 or more | 0.95 |
| 12 to 19 | 0.97 |
| fewer than 12 | no share |

## Cases (hypothetical)

- 22 AutoPay debits posted in the time, 2 of them returned: 20: 0.95.
- 20 posted, 1 returned: 19: 0.97.
- 12 posted, 1 returned: 11: no share.
